title: HVAC Equipment Sales
description:
HVAC Equipment Sales Representative

Location: Epping, NH (Remote/Field-Based)

Job Summary

Seeking a motivated HVAC Equipment Sales Representative to drive sales of HVAC systems, air conditioning, oil and propane heating equipment, generators, and related energy solutions throughout New Hampshire. This is a field-based role focused on prospecting, conducting customer consultations, preparing proposals, and closing high-value equipment sales.

Responsibilities

  • Generate new business and grow existing accounts.
  • Conduct in-home and on-site sales appointments.
  • Prepare and present proposals and equipment recommendations.
  • Manage opportunities and customer relationships using ServiceTitan.
  • Work closely with service, operations, and administrative support teams.
  • Meet or exceed annual sales goals of $2.5M–$3M.

Requirements

  • 5+ years of outside sales experience in HVAC, generators, energy systems, industrial equipment, or other large-ticket sales.
  • ServiceTitan experience required.
  • Ability to understand HVAC, mechanical, electrical, and fuel-system components.
  • Strong presentation, negotiation, and closing skills.
  • Valid driver's license and clean driving record.
  • Bachelor's degree preferred or equivalent experience.

Compensation

  • Base salary + Industry competitive commission structure (200K + OTE).

Sales Support

  • Company-provided leads (typically 2–4 per day during peak season).
  • Dedicated administrative support for proposals, customer preparation, and follow-up.
  • Opportunity to prepare 4–5 proposals per day during busy periods.
  • Strong brand recognition and established sales process.

Work Environment

  • Remote and on-the-road position with office access available.
  • Daily team meetings:
    • Sales & Service Stand-Up: 8:30 AM
    • Close-Out & Prep Call: 2:30 PM
  • Collaborative team culture with extensive operational and administrative support.

title: Warehouse Worker
description:
We are seeking a dedicated and reliable Warehouse Worker to join our team. The ideal candidate will possess a strong work ethic, have at least 1 year of warehouse experience, and the ability to learn how to operate a forklift.

Job Overview

  • Packages products.
  • Operate sit-down forklift 
  • Obtains drums, pails and other items from storage areas.
  • Packs finished ink batches.
  • Occasionally repacks materials.
  • Marks and labels drums, pails, or containers as specified on batch slip or shipping order.
  • Replenishes base inks and additives from supply stocks as needed.
  • Assembles, packs, and identifies for shipment, various inks from factory orders.
  • Picks up orders from office and Obtains those items available from stock and those prepared as above
  • Obtains the bills of lading or other shipping documents from the office and prepares them for shipment.
  • Telephones truck lines and other carriers for pick up.
  • Must have basic computer skills
  • Ability to lift 50+ pounds

title: Production Supervisor
description:
Production Supervisor 
Grand Rapids, MI 
Pay: $35.00 per hour 
6:00 AM - 6:00 PM 
26-06927

Job Summary

The Production Supervisor is responsible for overseeing daily production operations to ensure the efficient, safe, and timely manufacturing of quality products. This role provides direct supervision of production associates, coordinates production activities with cross-functional departments, monitors product quality, and promotes continuous improvement initiatives while maintaining compliance with food safety, quality, and workplace safety standards.

Job Responsibilities

  • Supervise daily production operations to ensure production schedules, quality standards, and delivery requirements are achieved.
  • Provide leadership, coaching, training, and performance feedback to production associates.
  • Promote a safe work environment by ensuring compliance with company policies and applicable local, state, and federal safety regulations.
  • Maintain compliance with food safety, food defense, Good Manufacturing Practices (GMP), Hazard Analysis and Critical Control Points (HACCP), Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs), and other quality requirements.
  • Support continuous improvement initiatives to reduce waste, improve efficiency, and increase productivity.
  • Coordinate production startup activities, including reviewing production orders, verifying equipment readiness, and confirming operating conditions.
  • Monitor product quality and implement approved formula or process adjustments as required.
  • Prepare production schedules and ensure adequate staffing to meet operational requirements.
  • Coordinate with maintenance, sanitation, shipping, and other departments to minimize downtime and maintain production efficiency.
  • Maintain accurate production records related to safety, quality, key performance indicators, and production output.
  • Support compliance with food safety and quality programs, regulatory requirements, and third-party audit standards.
  • Conduct incident investigations and implement corrective and preventive actions as needed.
  • Promote Lean manufacturing principles and continuous process improvement.
  • Perform other duties as assigned.

Job Requirements

  • Minimum of 2 to 5 years of supervisory experience in a production, food manufacturing, food processing, or fast-paced manufacturing environment required.
  • High school diploma or equivalent required.
  • Some college coursework preferred.
  • Strong leadership, coaching, and employee development skills.
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills.
  • Strong organizational, problem-solving, and time management skills.
  • Proficiency with Microsoft Office applications; experience with workforce management systems such as Kronos preferred.
  • Ability to manage multiple priorities in a fast-paced manufacturing environment.
  • Knowledge of food safety principles, GMP, HACCP, and quality systems.
  • Understanding of Lean manufacturing and continuous improvement methodologies preferred.
  • Willingness to work flexible schedules, including nights, weekends, and holidays.

Education

  • High school diploma or equivalent required.
  • Some college coursework preferred.

Work Experience

  • Minimum of 2 to 5 years of supervisory experience in a production, food manufacturing, food processing, or fast-paced manufacturing environment required.
